title: Tabbed crew card
prompt: Build a card for a crew member named "Ada Okafor" (heading), with the line "Flight engineer, Orbit 7" below it. Inside the card, show three tabs: "Overview" (text: "Leads the docking checklist."), "Passes" (text: "Next close pass in four days.") and "History" (text: "Charted since March."). Overview is selected first. The card has a footer with a quiet button "Remove from crew" and a primary button "Save changes".
